article.title: MANAGING MULTIPLE TABLETS IN A RESTAURANT
article.body_html:
With the world moving towards more and more delivery applications, it is important that you are using your devices in an efficient manner without taking your much-needed counter space. The iBOLT Tablet Tower series is here to support you! If you are currently suffering from “Tablet-itus”, this article will help you decide what tablet management system is best for you.

 

HOW DO YOU MANAGE MULTIPLE TABLETS?

The iBOLT Tablet tower series makes it easy to mount multiple tablets in a single location. You can mount from 3-5 tablets at once and we offer different mounting options and security solutions to fit your restaurant's needs. Most restaurants have multiple tablets to manage for UberEats, DoorDash, GrubHub, Postmates, Yelp, etc.

 

WHAT TYPE OF MOUNTING OPTIONS DO YOU CURRENTLY OFFER?

Clamp/Drill base towers are designed to install directly on a table top, counter, or flat surface. These kits include 2 different types of mounting bases (C-Clamp and Drill base).

 

Available in multiple tablet quantities below:

Three tablet Holders

Four Tablet Holders

Five Tablet Holders
 As requested, Wall mount versions are now available! The wall mount Tablet towers feature heavy duty metal drill base mounting brackets to easily install on a wall or other flat surface.

 

Available in multiple tablet quantities below:

Three tablet Holders

Four Tablet Holders

Five Tablet Holders

 We also have single tablet mounting stands and clamps that are ideal for POS systems. To view all of our Point of Sale stands, mounts, and clamps view our point of sale category here: https://iboltmounts.com/industries/retail-services/point-of-sale 

ARE YOU ABLE TO EASILY REMOVE THE TABLETS, SO YOU CAN TAKE THEM TO THE POS FOR ORDERING?

Yes, our tablet holders feature a clamp mechanism on the back of the holder that makes it easy to flip the level and remove your tablet. All our standard restaurant tablet mounts feature our Universal TabDock Cradle which fits 7 to 10 inch tablets, including the iPad Gen 8 and Samsung Tab A. If security is concern, our locking tablet mount is the perfect solution. These tablets can be removed from the holder with the included keys.

CAN YOU ADD MORE TABLETS?

Yes we have additional tablet clamp mounts available here

HOW DO YOU KEEP THE TABLETS CHARGED?

While we don't currently offer a specific charging or cable management system for this series yet, all ports are open on your device for charging purposes. Charging cables can be easily  lined down the pole to make your cable management easier. We also offer 2m long charging cables for when the mount is extended fully.

 

The iBOLT Tablet Tower Series is perfect for restaurants or anywhere else that requires you to have multiple tablets in a limited space. We are constantly expanding our line of point of sale mounting solutions so look out for more options coming soon! Next to be released is a heavy duty magnetic mount for 2 to 3 tablets. It is ideal for mounting on refrigerators/ freezers/ or other large metal surfaces.
